long_description:
Blueshoe is a full-stack law firm that helps people with everything from everyday legal issues to high-stakes litigation and trial.

People can access legal guidance directly through our web app or the AI interfaces where they are already seeking answers. If representation is needed, Blueshoe attorneys handle many cases all the way to resolution, equipped with cutting-edge data, AI-native tools, and operational support.
name: Blueshoe
one_liner: The AI-Native Consumer + Plaintiff Law Firm
